about: A pure-Python library for reading, splitting, merging and changing PDF files.

prs.title: PDF text extraction puts spaces in the right places
prs.broken: Text pulled from LaTeX PDFs split words at kerned letters and joined words after a font change, giving text like "F rameworks" and "Programming:Python".
prs.changed: Only a forward move adds a space, and a gap after a font change is now seen.
prs.matters: Text extracted for search and AI tools reads as it does on the page.
